newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Khong Guan can't settle property talks.
newsitem.headline: Khong Guan can't settle property talks.

text.p: Khong Guan Holdings Malaysia Bhd said on Tuesday it was unable to finalise negotiations for a proposed acquisition of two properties within the period allowed for the suspension of its stock.

"We have been unable to finalise negotiations because of delays in producing independent valuation reports to support the price of the said lands," the property and confectionery firm said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
The company is in negotiations with the vendors of two properties in southern Johor state.
The stock exchange said Khong Guan stock will be requoted on Wednesday.
The stock was last traded on May 30 at 10.60 ringgit.
